decisions.reason: The no-limit and no-expiration language modifies the $5 coded-referral commission, not Small Block ticket eligibility, expiration, or prize parameters.
The commission limit and expiration decision does not change Big Block ticket eligibility, expiration, or prize parameters.
The source change concerns repeated commissions earned through a supplied referral code; it does not change allocation of a no-code mint's commission to a random holder.
Unlimited, non-expiring coded-referral commissions do not alter which NFT state transfers or who owns the transferred referral code.
The commission duration and limit do not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The existing message-156 MODIFY already records the About-page statement that referral commissions have no limits or expiration, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Message 156 supplies About-page revisions rather than a replacement or revision of the approved FAQ content.
Removing limits and expiration from coded-referral commissions does not change the $5 per-qualifying-mint allocation or any other primary-sale allocation amount.
The source does not change wallet requirements, authentication, or fiat-user access to commissions and prize areas.
Commission limits and expiration do not affect the separate unresolved choice between automatic prize delivery and a claim-button flow.
The coded-referral commission duration and limit do not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, funding, or ticket-generation rules.
Unlimited, non-expiring commissions do not change badge triggers, milestone thresholds, destinations, or current badge functions.
